# The deep trench

## How deep it goes

The trench is 3 to 7 miles deep along most of its length. Sunlight reaches only the first 600 feet of water. Below that, the sea is completely dark.

## Life at the bottom

Animals here survive crushing pressure. The pressure at the bottom is about 1,000 times the pressure at the surface. Most animals are small, pale and slow.

## A place we barely know

More people have walked on the Moon than have visited the deepest part of the ocean. We have mapped the surface of Mars in more detail than the sea floor.
